title: Fix dnf error: operation requires superuser privileges
summary: dnf installs and removes software for the whole system, so it needs administrator rights. If you run it as a normal user, it stops with a 'requires superuser privileges' message. Put sudo in front of the command.

aliases.text: днф установка не работает нет прав

error_patterns: The requested operation requires superuser privileges

steps.explain: Check which user you are running commands as. If it prints your own user name and not 'root', dnf was started without administrator rights.
steps.expect: Prints your user name, for example alex. It is not 'root', so the install needs sudo.

steps.explain: Run the same install with sudo in front. sudo asks for your account password once; nothing appears while you type it, which is normal.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the package to install

steps.expect: After the password, dnf lists the packages, asks for confirmation, and ends with 'Complete!'.

rollback.explain: Remove the package again if it was the wrong one.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the package to remove

warnings: sudo runs the install with full system rights. Install only packages you trust.
Verified on Fedora 42 (dnf5). Other Fedora or RHEL versions may print a different message.

source.title: dnf manual; card written and verified in the lnxhelp sandbox
